cinematic_dialogue:2:1524513002:.text: Roli? What are you doing here?

say:5:1524512001:1.text: The healing wound shows Kal's out of immediate danger. Now, we just need to wait for her to wake up.
say:5:1524512001:1.source_cn: 伤口开始愈合，说明她已经暂时脱离危险了。接下来只要等她...

say:6:1524512002:1.text: She wouldn't have made it without your powerful magic.
say:6:1524512002:1.source_cn: 她这次伤得不轻，幸好有你们这么强大的魔法帮忙。

say:8:1524512004:1.text: Thank you so much for saving Mama's life, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>...
say:8:1524512004:1.male: Thank you so much for saving Mama's life, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>...
say:8:1524512004:1.female: Thank you so much for saving Mama's life, Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>...

say:9:1524512005:0.text: I was terrified when the hunters carried Mama back. I felt like I was in a nightmare.
say:9:1524512005:0.source_cn: 看到被抬回来的阿娘，我真的很害怕，甚至觉得有点不真实。
say:9:1524512005:0.male: I was terrified when the hunters carried Mama back. I felt like I was in a nightmare.
say:9:1524512005:0.female: I was terrified when the hunters carried Mama back. I felt like I was in a nightmare.

say:10:1524512006:0.text: Mama's always been tough in front of me... I've never seen her so frail.
say:10:1524512006:0.source_cn: 在我的印象里，阿娘一直是风风火火的、强势又骄傲的样子…...
say:10:1524512006:0.male: Mama's always been tough in front of me... I've never seen her so frail.
say:10:1524512006:0.female: Mama's always been tough in front of me... I've never seen her so frail.

choice_prompt:11:1524512006.text: Mama's always been tough in front of me... I've never seen her so frail.
choice_prompt:11:1524512006.source_cn: 在我的印象里，阿娘一直是风风火火的、强势又骄傲的样子……我从来没见过她这么虚弱。
choice_prompt:11:1524512006.male: Mama's always been tough in front of me... I've never seen her so frail.
choice_prompt:11:1524512006.female: Mama's always been tough in front of me... I've never seen her so frail.

say:13:1524512008:0.text: Mama was once the tribe's best warrior... She used to be out hunting all day and only came back at night, rarely spending time with me.
say:13:1524512008:0.source_cn: 我阿娘一直是部落里最优秀的战士……她每天都带着狩猎队在...
say:13:1524512008:0.male: Mama was once the tribe's best warrior... She used to be out hunting all day and only came back at night, rarely spending time with me.
say:13:1524512008:0.female: Mama was once the tribe's best warrior... She used to be out hunting all day and only came back at night, rarely spending time with me.

say:14:1524512009:0.text: I thought we'd get along better once she quit hunting...
say:14:1524512009:0.source_cn: 我以为……以为只要没有狩猎队，她不那么执着当战士，我们...
say:14:1524512009:0.male: I thought we'd get along better once she quit hunting...
say:14:1524512009:0.female: I thought we'd get along better once she quit hunting...

say:15:1524512010:1.text: Little did I know, things actually got worse between us. She became obsessed with making me a warrior.
say:15:1524512010:1.source_cn: 可是当她退出狩猎队之后，她就开始强硬地逼着我训练，说要...
say:15:1524512010:1.male: Little did I know, things actually got worse between us. She became obsessed with making me a warrior.
say:15:1524512010:1.female: Little did I know, things actually got worse between us. She became obsessed with making me a warrior.

say:16:1524512011:0.source_cn: ……战士、战士，又是战士！阿娘到底为什么这么执着于战士？

say:17:1524512012:0.text: I don't care about being a warrior! It's because of Mama that I've lost all interest!
say:17:1524512012:0.source_cn: 我根本不在意是否成为战士！我不想当战士，全是因为阿娘！
say:17:1524512012:0.male: I don't care about being a warrior! It's because of Mama that I've lost all interest!
say:17:1524512012:0.female: I don't care about being a warrior! It's because of Mama that I've lost all interest!

say:18:1524512013:0.text: Mama neglected me when she was a warrior... And now she wants to train me into one...
say:18:1524512013:0.source_cn: 为了战士，阿娘选择抛下我……现在又就用战士的标准要求我...
say:18:1524512013:0.male: Mama neglected me when she was a warrior... And now she wants to train me into one...
say:18:1524512013:0.female: Mama neglected me when she was a warrior... And now she wants to train me into one...

say:19:1524512014:1.text: Nothing matters more to her than the so-called "warrior's glory"... I hate it! It's kept her trapped her whole life!
say:19:1524512014:1.source_cn: 她做这些，都是为了所谓的“战士的荣耀”……我讨厌它！是...
say:19:1524512014:1.male: Nothing matters more to her than the so-called "warrior's glory"... I hate it! It's kept her trapped her whole life!
say:19:1524512014:1.female: Nothing matters more to her than the so-called "warrior's glory"... I hate it! It's kept her trapped her whole life!

say:21:1524512016:1.text: I may not be a warrior, but as their healer, I know a thing or two about their mindset. I can share my view if you want to hear it.
say:21:1524512016:1.source_cn: 虽然我并非战士，但作为负责治疗他们的巫祭，我对他们的想...

say:22:1524512017:0.text: As I see it, the "warrior's glory" isn't a constraint, but a responsibility.
say:22:1524512017:0.source_cn: 在我看来，“战士的荣耀”并不是什么束缚，而是一种责任。

say:24:1524512019:1.text: You heard it right. The warriors take it upon themselves to remain united and defend the tribe.
say:24:1524512019:1.source_cn: 没错。身为战士，团结一致、保护族人、捍卫部落的责任。

say:25:1524512020:1.text: It emboldens them to confront the beasts and bring food back to their families.
say:25:1524512020:1.source_cn: 正因为有它的存在，战士们才拥有了在森林中与野兽搏杀的勇...

say:26:1524512021:1.text: Even though I chose the path of magic, I can relate to my people's passion for becoming warriors.
say:26:1524512021:1.source_cn: 我虽然选择学习魔法，但我能理解我们的同胞对于成为战士的执着。

say:27:1524512022:1.text: Remember, it's warriors who built our tribe.
say:27:1524512022:1.source_cn: 因为雅库伯尔，不正是由一群战士建立起来的吗？

say:28:1524512023:0.text: I... never thought about these things before...

cinematic_dialogue:31:1524513002:.text: Roli? What are you doing here?

say:35:1524514001:1.text: I remember... jumping in front of a beast, and it scratched my back...
say:35:1524514001:1.source_cn: 我记得……我挡在野兽前面，然后被它抓伤了后背……

say:36:1524514002:1.text: Are the hunters safe? My injury was quite bad... I thought...
say:36:1524514002:1.source_cn: 对了，狩猎队呢，他们还好吗？还有我的伤……我记得受的伤...

say:37:1524514003:1.text: Take it slow. Your wound is still raw, so stay still.
say:37:1524514003:1.source_cn: 冷静一点，你的伤刚愈合，不能乱动。

say:38:1524514004:1.text: Thanks to your warning, the hunters responded to the ambush in time. Some were injured, but none as seriously as you.
say:38:1524514004:1.source_cn: 多亏你的提醒，狩猎队反应及时，虽然有几个人受了伤，但都...

say:39:1524514005:1.text: If you're wondering how you pulled through, you can thank this gentleman's powerful magic.
say:39:1524514005:1.source_cn: 至于你的伤为什么能恢复得这么快，这多亏了<style=...
say:39:1524514005:1.male: If you're wondering how you pulled through, you can thank this gentleman's powerful magic.
say:39:1524514005:1.female: If you're wondering how you pulled through, you can thank this lady's powerful magic.

choice_prompt:40:1524514005.text: If you're wondering how you pulled through, you can thank this gentleman's powerful magic.
choice_prompt:40:1524514005.source_cn: 至于你的伤为什么能恢复得这么快，这多亏了<style=stress><player_name></style>。凭借<male>他</male><female>她</female>高深的魔法，我们才能救回你。
choice_prompt:40:1524514005.male: If you're wondering how you pulled through, you can thank this gentleman's powerful magic.
choice_prompt:40:1524514005.female: If you're wondering how you pulled through, you can thank this lady's powerful magic.

say:41:1524514007:1.text: In our entire tribe, only this gentleman and Gala possess such power. Maybe Roli, too.
say:41:1524514007:1.source_cn: 放眼整个雅库伯尔，只有<male>他</male><f...
say:41:1524514007:1.male: In our entire tribe, only this gentleman and Gala possess such power. Maybe Roli, too.
say:41:1524514007:1.female: In our entire tribe, only this lady and Gala possess such power. Maybe Roli, too.

say:43:1524514009:1.text: I believe Roli has it in her to become as great as her masters.
say:43:1524514009:1.source_cn: 以绒利的天赋，她将来或许也可以做到。

say:44:1524514010:1.source_cn: 魔法……竟然能做到这样神奇的事。

say:45:1524514011:0.text: If there had been such powerful mages to help me back then, I might not have had to quit hunting...
say:45:1524514011:0.source_cn: 如果当初部落里也有这样多厉害的魔法师，我……或许也不会...

say:47:1524514013:0.text: Mama, I want to apologize. I... I shouldn't have rejected everything about being a warrior, and I regret the hurtful things I said to you.
say:47:1524514013:0.source_cn: 阿娘，我想和你道歉。我……我不该那么排斥战士的一切，还...

say:48:1524514014:1.text: Today, you jumped into danger to protect your peers... That was heroic!
say:48:1524514014:1.source_cn: 你今天冲出去保护其他人的事情……很勇敢，很厉害！

say:51:1524514017:1.text: ... Mama owes you an apology too, my dear.

say:52:1524514018:1.text: All this time, I've been forcing you to learn from me, and I ignored your thoughts...
say:52:1524514018:1.source_cn: 一直以来，我只想要把自己的战斗技巧都教给你，却忽略了你...

say:54:1524514020:1.text: You have extraordinary talent in magic, so being a warrior may not be the best path for you.
say:54:1524514020:1.source_cn: 你的魔法天赋那么出众，当战士未必是最好的选择。

say:55:1524514021:1.text: I won't stand in your way anymore... Do whatever your heart desires.
say:55:1524514021:1.source_cn: 我不再阻拦你……你想做什么，就去做什么吧。

say:57:1524514023:0.text: Mama, I... I'm willing to learn some warrior skills from you, but I want to focus more on studying magic.
say:57:1524514023:0.source_cn: 阿娘，我……我愿意学习一些战士的技巧，但我还是更想以学...

say:58:1524514024:0.text: I hope to save more lives in the future, just like Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> did for you.
say:58:1524514024:0.source_cn: 因为，我希望以后也能救助更多受伤的战士，就像<styl...
say:58:1524514024:0.male: I hope to save more lives in the future, just like Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> did for you.
say:58:1524514024:0.female: I hope to save more lives in the future, just like Master <style="stress"><player_name></style> did for you.

say:59:1524514025:0.text: I suppose it's also one way to uphold the "warrior's glory."
say:59:1524514025:0.source_cn: 对于雅库伯尔来说……这也是一种延续“战士的荣耀”的方法吧？

say:60:1524514026:1.text: Roli, you really think that? I'm so glad you finally got it... *Cough*
say:60:1524514026:1.source_cn: 绒利，你真的是这样想的吗？你终于明白……咳咳……

say:61:1524514027:1.text: Don't get up! Your injury hasn't fully healed yet!
say:61:1524514027:1.source_cn: 别动！你的伤还没好全，还不能起来！

say:62:1524514028:1.text: Mama, please stay in bed! We can't risk your wound reopening!
say:62:1524514028:1.source_cn: 阿娘，你先好好休息！回头伤口又裂开了怎么办？

say:63:1524514029:1.text: Come with me, I'll prepare more medicine for you.
say:63:1524514029:1.source_cn: 唉，跟我来吧，我再给你制一些药。

say:67:1524514031:0.text: ... Ah! I almost forgot Master Gala's still waiting for my reply!
say:67:1524514031:0.source_cn: ……对了，加拉老师还在等着我的回复！
say:67:1524514031:0.male: ... Ah! I almost forgot Master Gala's still waiting for my reply!
say:67:1524514031:0.female: ... Ah! I almost forgot Master Gala's still waiting for my reply!

say:68:1524514032:1.text: I have to let her know my decision. I just hope she won't be upset...
say:68:1524514032:1.source_cn: 我得赶紧把我决定同时学魔法和战士技巧的事告诉她！唔，不...
say:68:1524514032:1.male: I have to let her know my decision. I just hope she won't be upset...
say:68:1524514032:1.female: I have to let her know my decision. I just hope she won't be upset...

choice_prompt:69:1524514032.text: I have to let her know my decision. I just hope she won't be upset...
choice_prompt:69:1524514032.source_cn: 我得赶紧把我决定同时学魔法和战士技巧的事告诉她！唔，不知道老师会不会生气……
choice_prompt:69:1524514032.male: I have to let her know my decision. I just hope she won't be upset...
choice_prompt:69:1524514032.female: I have to let her know my decision. I just hope she won't be upset...

say:71:1524514034:0.text: Let's visit Master Gala right away!
say:71:1524514034:0.source_cn: 那我们这就出发，去找加拉老师吧！
say:71:1524514034:0.male: Let's visit Master Gala right away!
say:71:1524514034:0.female: Let's visit Master Gala right away!

choice:69:1:2.text: Time to get rewards from Gala!
choice:69:1:2.male: Time to get rewards from Gala!
choice:69:1:2.female: Time to get rewards from Gala!

narration:74:1505151902:0.text: When Kal opens her eyes, Roli rushes to her mother, unable to hold back her tears.
narration:74:1505151902:0.source_cn: 看到嘉苏醒，绒利再也控制不住自己，哭着跑了过去。

choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 她的确是位优秀的战士

choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 但再强的战士也会受伤

narration:75:1505151901:0.text: Thanks to your combined efforts with Roli and the priestess, the badly injured Kal is rescued. Roli bursts into tears of joy seeing her mother's wounds begin to heal.
narration:75:1505151901:0.source_cn: 你与绒利、巫祭齐心协力，终于救下了重伤的嘉。见到她的伤...

narration:75:1505151901:0.female: Thanks to your combined efforts with Roli and the priestess, the badly injured Kal is rescued. Roli bursts into tears of joy seeing her mother's wounds begin to heal.
